apiHealth.bootingDelay: The server and its database sleep when nobody plays: waking them up takes up to about thirty seconds.

cheat.ignored: A message ({chain, select, chess {chess} chat {chat} other {}}) from {author} is ignored by {sequencer}, reported by {reporters}

presentation.caption: White has picked a move, which Black does not see before playing theirs.
presentation.intro: No more advantage for White: each turn, both players pick a move without knowing their opponent's, then the two moves are revealed and played together.

points.intermediateTurn: A piece venturing onto an attacked square can be captured in an intermediate turn.
points.kingCapture: A king can be captured outright, even without checkmate.
points.sameSquare: Two pieces heading for the same square capture each other, and two pieces can swap places.

presentation.rooms: Create a room, private with a password, or join one of the open rooms. Each participant picks a color; the others watch the game.
presentation.tagline: Chess where both players move at the same time.
presentation.title: Synchronous chess

chat.description: A chat between the participants of a room, their messages sent peer to peer.
chat.title: Chat

chess.description: Chess where both players move at the same time: each one picks a move without knowing the other's.
chess.title: Synchronous chess

home.intro: Create a room, or join one of the open rooms: the players connect directly to each other.

create.intro: The other players will find it in the list of the open rooms: with a password, it is private.
